ASSET_IN_USE.zh: 发布版本仍在引用此素材
ASSET_IN_USE.en: A draft or published version still references this asset.

ASSET_KIND_MISMATCH.zh: 素材类型与上传入口不符
ASSET_KIND_MISMATCH.en: Choose a file matching the requested image or audio type.

ASSET_TOO_LARGE.zh: 素材超过 10 MB，请移除后重新上传
ASSET_TOO_LARGE.en: The asset exceeds the 10 MB limit.

BLOCKED.zh: 此 Skill 已被管理下架
BLOCKED.en: This Skill was removed by an administrator.

COMPLIANCE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.zh: 请确认拥有内容的使用与发布授权，并同意当前公开范围
COMPLIANCE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.en: Confirm your rights to publish the content and the selected public scope.

CONCURRENCY_LIMIT.en: Too many conversations are generating replies.

CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.zh: 人格与当前输入超过连接的输入字符预算，请缩短输入或调整预算
CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.en: The persona and message exceed the input budget.

CSRF_REJECTED.zh: 会话校验失败，请刷新重试
CSRF_REJECTED.en: Your session has changed. Please sign in again.

DRAFT_CHANGED.zh: 内容已在其他页面更新，请刷新后再提交
DRAFT_CHANGED.en: This draft has changed. Reload it before saving.

DUPLICATE_MEMORY.zh: 记忆 ID 不可重复

FILE_TOO_LARGE.en: The uploaded file exceeds the size limit.

FORBIDDEN.en: You do not have permission to perform this action.

GITHUB_BRANCH_NOT_FOUND.zh: 目标分支不存在，请联系管理员
GITHUB_BRANCH_NOT_FOUND.en: The target branch does not exist. Contact an administrator.

GITHUB_CHECK_FAILED.zh: 无法访问 GitHub 仓库或分支
GITHUB_CHECK_FAILED.en: The repository or branch is unavailable. Check the token and permissions.

GITHUB_COMMIT_FAILED.en: GitHub could not create the commit.

GITHUB_CONFIG_INVALID.zh: 平台 GitHub 仓库配置无效，请联系管理员
GITHUB_CONFIG_INVALID.en: The GitHub repository configuration is invalid.

GITHUB_CONFIG_REQUIRED.zh: 平台 GitHub 仓库或凭据未配置，每周同步等待管理员配置；平台内容可正常使用
GITHUB_CONFIG_REQUIRED.en: GitHub synchronization is waiting for repository credentials. Platform publishing is still available.

GITHUB_DISABLED.zh: 平台 GitHub 同步尚未启用，请联系管理员

GITHUB_LEGACY_JOB.zh: 旧 App 任务不能转投统一仓库，请联系管理员核对原提交
GITHUB_LEGACY_JOB.en: This legacy job cannot be sent to the current repository.

GITHUB_PERMISSION_REQUIRED.zh: Owner 令牌没有目标仓库的写入权限
GITHUB_PERMISSION_REQUIRED.en: The token needs write permission for the target repository.

GITHUB_SCHEDULE_INVALID.zh: 每周同步时间配置无效
GITHUB_SCHEDULE_INVALID.en: The weekly synchronization schedule is invalid.

GITHUB_TARGET_CHANGED.zh: 目标已变更，不能重试旧目标任务
GITHUB_TARGET_CHANGED.en: The repository target changed. This job cannot be retried.

INCOMPLETE_SKILL.en: Complete the required Skill content before submitting.

INCOMPLETE_STREAM.en: The reply ended early. Please try again.

INVALID_ASSET_KIND.zh: 请选择图片或声音素材
INVALID_ASSET_KIND.en: Choose an image or audio asset.

INVALID_ASSET_PATH.zh: 素材必须引用 assets/ 下的文件
INVALID_ASSET_PATH.en: Assets must reference files under assets/.

INVALID_CODE.en: The verification code is invalid, expired or already used.

INVALID_EMAIL.en: Please enter a valid email address.

INVALID_FIELD.en: Check the field format and length.

INVALID_KEY_ACTION.en: Choose keep, replace or clear for the API key.

INVALID_LOGIN.zh: 邮箱或密码错误，或账号不可用
INVALID_LOGIN.en: The email or password is incorrect, or the account is unavailable.

INVALID_MEDIA.en: Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, WAV, OGG or MP3 media.

INVALID_MODEL_LIST.zh: 厂商返回了无法识别的模型列表
INVALID_MODEL_LIST.en: The provider returned an invalid model list.

INVALID_PARAMETERS.en: Check the model timeout, token limit and other parameters.

INVALID_PASSWORD.zh: 密码须为 8–128 位，且包含字母和数字
INVALID_PASSWORD.en: Use 8–128 characters including letters and digits.

INVALID_PROTOCOL.en: The model protocol is not supported.

INVALID_PUBLICATION.zh: 发布范围包含不存在的记忆
INVALID_PUBLICATION.en: The publication scope contains unavailable content.

INVALID_STATUS.zh: 不能停用自己，状态须为 active 或 disabled
INVALID_STATUS.en: The requested account or job status is invalid.

INVALID_STREAM.en: The model returned an invalid stream.

INVALID_ZIP.en: The ZIP file could not be read.

MISSING_ASSET.zh: 素材不存在或不属于当前用户
MISSING_ASSET.en: An asset is missing or does not belong to this account.

MODEL_ERROR.en: The model could not generate a reply.

MODEL_NETWORK_BLOCKED.zh: 后端运行环境禁止连接模型服务，请以允许联网的方式重启后端
MODEL_NETWORK_BLOCKED.en: The backend cannot access the model service. Check its network permissions.

NOT_RETRYABLE.en: Only eligible failed jobs can be retried.

NO_KEY.zh: 请先输入 API Key，再获取模型列表

NO_PROFILE.zh: 请先配置并选择自己的模型连接

NO_SKILL.zh: 未找到 mind.json、.mind 或 SKILL.md
NO_SKILL.en: The package must contain mind.json, .mind or SKILL.md.

NO_TEXT.en: The model did not return text.

ORIGIN_REJECTED.en: This request could not be verified. Please reload the page.

OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE.en: The model output exceeds the size limit.

PERSONA_CONFLICT.zh: mind.json 与 SKILL.md 人格不一致，请修改后重新上传
PERSONA_CONFLICT.en: The personas in mind.json and SKILL.md conflict.

PROFILE_CHANGED.zh: 原模型连接不可用，请显式重新选择连接
PROFILE_CHANGED.en: The original model connection changed. Select a connection again.

PROFILE_NOT_READY.zh: 请输入密钥并确认发送文本至该厂商
PROFILE_NOT_READY.en: Confirm the data scope and test the model connection first.

RATE_LIMIT.zh: 请求过于频繁，请稍后再试
RATE_LIMIT.en: Too many requests. Please try again later.

REQUEST_REUSED.zh: 同一请求标识不能用于不同内容
REQUEST_REUSED.en: A request ID cannot be reused for different content.

SLUG_READONLY.zh: 包名由系统分配，不能修改
SLUG_READONLY.en: The package name is assigned by the system and cannot be changed.

UNSAFE_ENDPOINT.zh: 仅支持公开 HTTPS 地址和 443 端口
UNSAFE_ENDPOINT.en: Use a public HTTPS endpoint on port 443.

UNSAFE_ZIP.zh: ZIP 包含不支持的路径/文件或文件过多
UNSAFE_ZIP.en: The ZIP contains unsafe paths, unsupported files or too many files.

UPSTREAM_TOO_LARGE.en: The model response exceeds the size limit.

ZIP_TOO_LARGE.en: The extracted ZIP content exceeds the size limit.

ALREADY_EXISTS.zh: 相同版本、名称或请求已存在
ALREADY_EXISTS.en: This version, name or request already exists.

INTERNAL_ERROR.zh: 服务暂时不可用，请检查运行状态
INTERNAL_ERROR.en: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.zh: 不支持此请求内容类型
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.en: This request content type is not supported.

UPSTREAM_ERROR.en: The model service rejected the request.

MODEL_CONNECTION_FAILED.zh: 模型连接中断，请检查配置或稍后重试
MODEL_CONNECTION_FAILED.en: The model connection was interrupted. Check the configuration or try again.

MESSAGE_SAVE_FAILED.zh: 回复保存失败，请刷新后检查会话
MESSAGE_SAVE_FAILED.en: The reply could not be saved. Reload the conversation.

HTTP_ERROR.en: The request failed. Please try again.

NETWORK_ERROR.zh: 网络连接失败，请检查网络后重试
NETWORK_ERROR.en: The network request failed. Check your connection.

INVALID_RESPONSE.zh: 服务返回了无效响应，请稍后重试
INVALID_RESPONSE.en: The service returned an invalid response.
